_about: The clean install (the owner 2026-10-08): the one services list every patrol reads, the guided init, the two opt-in patrols, the night's unit-registry refresh, the coders' and reviewer's maps, the panel contract.

services.about: crew/lib/krew_services.py: $KREW_HOME/services.json (schema krew-services/v1), the one list the keeper, janitor, Daily, Steward's log collect, restart window, boot check and panel tiles read; discovery for init. config/services.example.json is the reference install's rows; config/unit-notes.example.json the registry's words.

init.about: krew-install init: Hermes at the pin + patches, the eight profiles with config, the endpoint and key, the services list from discovery (named and approved by the owner), the loops named with --enable.

patrols.about: Opt-in, off by default: krew-tool-watch.py (the front door's tool-call failure rate, one card per jump when armed) and krew-wall-tab-probe.py (the Wall's page through its player, one card per dead episode when armed); their units.

skills-maps.about: bash-map, lila-map, vera-map: one lookup, then the skill to load (the coders' and the reviewer's indexes, beside ada-map, scout-map, steward-map, zoey-map).

docs-contracts.about: docs/PANEL-CONTRACT.md: what the Crissa Control Panel must do with krew's add-on manifest (sections, Run now, Off). docs/KREW-GOVERNANCE.md: the second-order sweep on design and change cards.
